secondary_times: all exact shared durations, reported separately by time
dose_rule: all positive dose pairs within factor 2; legacy nearest and unrestricted-nearest sensitivity separate
strict: same confirmed Cellosaurus, all eligible cells and near-dose pairs
marginal: each source own complete eligible cell set including source-specific unmapped cell labels; not pure beta and not same-cell equivalence
weighting: mean dose pairs within drug x cell, cells within drug, drugs within chemical supercomponent for Tahoe pairs; otherwise drug equal; never treat dose multiplicity as independent drugs
metrics: R3 common-drug background within exact cell/time/dose-pair blocks >=3 drugs
same-background retrieval for blocks >=2 drugs; fixed candidate pools

gene_axis_sensitivity.rule: maximal unique Entrez intersection of the six retained source releases; same locked condition supports; metadata-derived before response reads

identity_correction.authority: official Tahoe PubChem CID full stereochemistry
identity_correction.reason: metadata conflict recheck; first numeric attempt invalidated independent of response values
